description: This PHP script manages the account preferences for campaign email reports in the Revive Adserver platform. It handles loading preferences, processing form submissions to update email warning settings for admins, managers, and advertisers, and rendering the preferences form with validation and messaging.

classes.description: Class for handling admin options and preferences display.

classes.description: Class for handling translation of messages.

classes.description: Model class for page header UI component.
